strategies.name: vwap_break_then_pullback_long
strategies.entry_summary: Trade a penny stock that opened weak below VWAP, then breaks above VWAP with strong volume and obvious bullish momentum. Enter on the subsequent pullback/retest near VWAP (or nearby obvious support like a whole-dollar level) expecting VWAP to hold as support and produce a bounce.
strategies.exit_summary: Manage as a scalp: sell into the bounce/upward continuation after the pullback entry, rather than chasing highs. The transcript teaches taking profit on the bounce as a quick scalp but does not provide multiple distinct exit variants beyond that general bounce-up profit-taking approach.

variants.variant_label: XCLB example pullback buy after VWAP break
variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: wait for a strong move over VWAP with consecutive green candles and volume, then buy the pullback
variants.target_note: scalp out on the bounce up after entry
variants.transcript_quote: we saw this big run up over the v wap the milestone level we bought into the pullback and we rode the bounce up scalping out of it

variants.variant_label: SOS example first bounce after pullback
variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: break above VWAP after earlier rejection, with volume coming in, then buy the pullback into the first few bounces
variants.target_note: ride the momentum bounce for profit
variants.transcript_quote: we can buy the pullback into that first few bounces you can see the momentum coming in after that pullback was really really nice

variants.timeframe_note: after the first hour or so after the open
variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: maintain below VWAP first, then push up through VWAP with about a million shares per minute and buy the pullback
variants.target_note: bounce up and ride that up for profit
variants.transcript_quote: we're looking to dip by into pull backs to the v-wop in anticipating a bounce at the v-wop level

result.enumeration_note: Only one strategy clears the evidence floor: a long VWAP-break pullback buy with scalp-style profit-taking on the bounce; the transcript gives filters and examples, not a separate opposing or differently managed strategy.
